verse.verse_1: By the angels who drag forth vehemently.
verse.verse_2: By the angels who release with gentle release.
verse.verse_3: By the angels who glide swimmingiy,
verse.verse_4: And then they speed with foremost speed.
verse.verse_5: And then they manage the affair,
verse.verse_6: A Day shall come whereon the quaking will quake,
verse.verse_7: And there will follow it the next blast.
verse.verse_8: Hearts on that Day will be throbbing;
verse.verse_10: They say: shall we indeed be restored to the first state,
verse.verse_11: When we have become bones decayed!
verse.verse_12: They say: that then shall be a losing return.
verse.verse_13: It will be only one scaring shout,
verse.verse_14: And lo! they all shall appear on the surface.
verse.verse_15: Hath there come Unto thee the story of Musa!
verse.verse_16: Recall what time his Lord called Unto him in the holy vale of Tuwa.
verse.verse_17: Saying:'go thou Unto Fir'awn; verily he hath waxen exorbitant.
verse.verse_18: Then say thou: 'wouldst thou to be purified?
verse.verse_19: Then shall guide thee Unto thy Lord so that thou shalt fear.
verse.verse_20: Then he shewed him the great sign.
verse.verse_23: Then he gathered and cried aloud,
verse.verse_24: And he said: I am Your Lord, most high.
verse.verse_25: Wherefore Allah laid hold of him with the punishment of the Hereafter and of the present.
verse.verse_26: Verily herein is lesson for him who feareth.
verse.verse_27: Are ye harder to create or the heaven which He hath builded?
verse.verse_28: He hath raised the height thereof and perfected it.
verse.verse_29: And He made dark its night, and brought forth its sunshine.
verse.verse_30: And the earth!- thereafter He stretched it out.
verse.verse_31: And he brought forth therefrom its water, and its pasture.
verse.verse_32: And the mountains! - He established them firm:
verse.verse_33: A provision for you and your cattle.
verse.verse_34: Then when the Grand Calamity shall come
verse.verse_35: The Day whereon man shall rember whatsoever he had striven for.
verse.verse_36: And the Scorch will be made apparent to any one who beholdeth.
verse.verse_37: Then as for him who waxed exorbitant,
verse.verse_38: And who chose the life of the world,
verse.verse_39: Verily the Scorch! that shall be his resort.
verse.verse_40: And as for him who dreaded standing before his Lord, and restrained his soul from lust,
verse.verse_41: Verily the Garden! -that shall be his resort.
verse.verse_42: They question thee of the Hour:'when will its arrival be?
verse.verse_43: Wherein art thou concerred with the declaration thereof!
verse.verse_44: Unto thy Lord is the Knowledge of the limit fixed therefor.
verse.verse_45: Thou art but a warner Unto him who feareth.
verse.verse_46: On the Day whereon they behold it, it will appear to them as though they had not tarried save an evening or the morn thereof.
